amendments: All trials subject to disclosed movement/sensor QC, not source random/initial50 sampling
No reward-status, measured-delay or movement-amplitude outcome selection
Whole-trial blocked split instead of flattened-timepoint CV
Full causal QC history instead of source startup padding
Movement-end planned window and exact count targets; no original smoothed-rate/figure reproduction claim

features: same-bin handle x/y mean and velocity
baseline.neural_features: same-bin mean GrC and/or binary CF events
baseline.selection: development MSE; ties smaller alpha; no refit
baseline.training: train-only mean/std and coefficients; unpenalized intercept

isolation.candidate_runtime: not implemented; independent sandbox/custody qualification required
isolation.cross_case_state: forbidden; real runtime reset not yet implemented

native_axes.axis_policy: Explicit source conventions; actual extraction/axis evidence remains a gate; no automatic transpose, squeeze or truncation

numerical_timestamp_policy.imaging: After movement-end rebase, snap a coordinate to the nearest100ms boundary iff distance<=1e-9 seconds. Other native timestamps retain values and bin side. Nearest-boundary bin owns equality.
numerical_timestamp_policy.interpretation: Declared numerical coordinate convention; physical clock accuracy remains unverified
numerical_timestamp_policy.overlap: Integer one-based source indices converted to zero-based half-open200/400tick intervals; floatseconds reporting only
numerical_timestamp_policy.scope: Same policy for whole-window crop and feature bins; start included and planned end excluded

primary_neural_condition: joint; GrC-only and CF-only are predeclared secondary ablations, never best-of-selected endpoints

quality.amendment: Every tested causal history must be fully observed; source filter startup padding is not observed data
quality.target_conditioning: Reward-aligned measured contacts used privately for sensor QC; report full exclusions and conditional population

scoring.null_or_negative_gain: valid result, no favored biological conclusion
scoring.primary: paired context_handle MSE minus candidate MSE
scoring.uncertainty: Per-mouse paired outputs implemented; inferential procedure and acceptance thresholds not yet qualified

split.cross_fold_input_overlap: refuse complete session; never selectively prune or fabricate independent samples
split.order: strict increasing source midpoint; do not sort or repair joins
split.source_preprocessing: Whole-recording processed GrC/CF; no fold-isolated native preprocessing claim

target.actual_reward_jitter: No claim planned interval is strictly before actual delivery
